messages:
jamie_support: Heads-up — getting a 5xx spike on hosted inference API since ~2026-03-17 10:42 UTC. ~7–9% 5xx on /v1/generate for a handful of orgs (acme-prod, greenbank). Example request-id: req_0a1b2c. Support ticket #45321 linked. Logs show gateway 502s and timeouts.

alice_oncall: ACK. I'm seeing gateway 502 / upstream timeouts in the edge traces. P50 ~1.2s, p95 ~5.8s over the last 10m window.

dev_deploy: I deployed release/rc-14 at 10:38 with the new batch_prefetch code behind a staged flag (slice=staged, 10%). Kicking a rollback now to false for that flag.

deploy-bot: rollback started: feature=batch_prefetch, slice=staged -> false. run_id=rb_3182468101. Estimated completion ~2m.

maria_sre: Quick question — does batch_prefetch change affect auth header propagation? Traces show some 401->502 cascades.

jamie_support: Customers are seeing both 502 and intermittent auth failures (401/403) around the same window. Possible retry storms from SDKs.

alice_oncall: repro snippet: ```curl -v -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' \n https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"input":"test"}'``` returns 502 with upstream "connection reset by peer" in gateway logs.

sam_customer_success: FYI one customer reported duplicate billing records — looks like client retried after timeout. Ticket escalated to billing.

maria_sre: Digging into traces: gateway -> auth-proxy -> model-router. Auth-proxy logs: "upstream timeout after 10s" and "502 from model-router: connection refused". Model-router shows short-lived connection limits spike right after rc-14 rollout.

dev_deploy: I'm expanding rollback to all slices and also bumping model-router pool by +2 nodes as a precaution (scale up request submitted). PR #8214 is the change set — it introduced a batching path that appears to mutate the header forwarding chain.

alice_oncall: Assigning to @maria_sre to own validation while rollback proceeds. I'll watch SLOs.

maria_sre: Rollback applied cluster-wide at 10:46 UTC. Error rate trending down — 5xx dropped from ~8% -> ~1.2% in 6 minutes. p95 latency down to ~1.1s.

jamie_support: Customers reporting recovery. Reaching out to affected accounts with interim notes.

dev_deploy: Root cause prelim: batch_prefetch path stripped or renamed 'x-auth-delegation' header for certain streaming subrequests; that caused auth-proxy to revalidate and occasionally fail, cascading to model-router connection churn. Hotfix in progress to preserve headers and add guard.

maria_sre: Action items: 1) revert flag (done), 2) hotfix PR with header-preserve (WIP), 3) add e2e canary that asserts auth header invariants, 4) run load repro in staging to validate.

sam_customer_success: I'll prepare customer comms and loop in billing for retry/dedup.

alice_oncall: We'll keep channel open for 30m until metrics stable. Thanks for fast rollback. :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: Incident summary auto-generated: impacted endpoints /v1/generate; root cause: batch_prefetch header handling regression in rc-14; mitigation: feature flag rollback + model-router scale-up; owner: maria_sre; follow-ups: create integration test + postmortem.

ops-bot: Channel will auto-archive after 1 hour of inactivity.
